title: cynanchum glaberrimum
intro: Cynanchum glaberrimum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family, is a species of vine native to China. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum glaberrimum include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
